testsuite.name: com.crush.mobile.ui.screens.chat.ChatContentGateTest

testcase.name: the field follows canType and the send button follows canSend
the question dialog releases the run and offers no option list
the question dialog dismiss also releases the run
dismissing the permission dialog is a deny and never an approval
allow once dispatches AllowOnce with the request id
always dispatches AllowForSession with the request id
the permission dialog shows the request and all three decisions are enabled and tappable
